title: LifegamesCopyAccessibility
description: Rich authoring schema for the a11y (accessibility) slice of @lifegames/copy. Every customer-facing accessibility string — aria-labels, image alt text, dialog labels, and pagination/region labels — is a CopyString leaf carrying authoring context in _meta. The two identity-slice a11y strings (skipToMain, ogImageAlt) intentionally remain in the identity namespace and are NOT duplicated here. The copy build derives a FLAT schema from this one (stripping _meta) for all consumer codegen (TS/Zod/Swift). Strings are authored in ICU MessageFormat 1 syntax; interpolated templates are substituted at the call site (no MessageFormat runtime). Casing is natural case: a11y copy needs no display uppercasing transform. The $defs block is byte-identical to schema/identity.schema.json and schema/widgets.schema.json; the $defs are inlined per schema file (no cross-file $ref), which the flat-schema derivation requires.

movement.title: A11yMovement
movement.description: Movement Rings widget accessibility labels — the rings progress summary and the daylight sun-arc image label.

identity.title: A11yIdentity
identity.description: Identity card accessibility labels — the avatar image alt text and the social-links nav region label.

bookshelf.title: A11yBookshelf
bookshelf.description: Bookshelf widget accessibility label — the per-book list-item aria-label template.

bookModal.title: A11yBookModal
bookModal.description: Book detail modal accessibility label — the dialog region label.

modal.title: A11yModal
modal.description: Generic modal accessibility label — the close-button aria-label (shared modal chrome).

readingFeed.title: A11yReadingFeed
readingFeed.description: Reading Feed widget accessibility label — the article pagination button aria-label template.

nav.title: A11yNav
nav.description: Top-level navigation landmark labels (web shell) — profile aside and dashboard nav.

region.title: A11yRegion
region.description: Triptych column region landmark labels (web shell) — the Body and Mind sections.

clock.title: A11yClock
clock.description: Live clock accessibility label (web shell) — the top-bar current-time readout.

page404.title: A11yPage404
page404.description: 404 page accessibility label (web shell) — the glitch error region.

CopyMeta.description: Authoring context attached to every copy leaf (D6). Drives auditing, reconciliation, and CI-lintable constraints.

description.description: What this string is and why it exists.

usage.description: Every render site / placement where this string appears (file:line or surface name). Makes duplication and placement visible for reconciliation (D11).

register.description: Voice register (see packages/copy/VOICE.md): atom | label | factual | expressive | machine | brand | consent.

audience.description: Primary audience: human | machine | dual. Drives the human↔AI arbitration rule (machine/dual surfaces stay literal/parseable).

lastReviewed.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the wording was last deliberately reviewed.

maxChars.description: Maximum rendered length. CI fails if value exceeds this.

rationale.description: Optional: why this wording/variant exists distinctly (intent, history).

CopyString.description: A single customer-facing string (ICU MF1 syntax) plus its authoring context.

value.description: The string, authored in ICU MessageFormat 1 syntax.

CopyStringList.description: An ordered list of customer-facing strings (each ICU MF1) plus shared authoring context.

value.description: The strings, each authored in ICU MessageFormat 1 syntax.
